name: Ride volatile spells in MACD's direction

history.reason: Failed the scorecard on both coins (rejected with Luke's say-so, 2026-11-14). Weekly hold: BTC Sharpe -0.13 vs 0.53 for holding, ETH 0.42 vs 0.46; walk-forward 0 and 1 of 5 windows; 26 and 19 trades; robustness no edge (BTC) and fragile (ETH). The daily switch was no better. Most of the study's spread was the down weeks, which a long-only account can only sit out.
